compartment.definition: The space external to the outermost structure of a cell. For cells without external protective or external encapsulating structures this refers to space outside of the plasma membrane. This term covers the host cell environment outside an intracellular parasite.
compartment.name: extracellular region

disease.definition: A viral infectious disease that results_in infection, has_material_basis_in Dengue virus [NCBITaxon:12637] with four serotypes (Dengue virus 1, 2, 3 and 4), which are transmitted_by Aedes mosquito bite. The infection has_symptom fever, has_symptom severe headache, has_symptom severe pain behind the eyes, has_symptom joint pain, has_symptom muscle and bone pain, has_symptom rash, and has_symptom mild bleeding.
name: dengue disease

summation.displayName: Dengue virus NS1 protein binds to prothrombin (Factor II, F2...
summation.text: Dengue virus NS1 protein binds to prothrombin (Factor II, F2) and inhibits its activation, which may contribute to hemorrhage in Dengue fever patients. This result was obtained from experiments with the Dengue serotype-2 (DENV-2) PL046 strain (Lin et al., 2012).
